BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Instruments and Sender Gauges

Q                    Water temp. gauge                    Defective indication

① With the ignition S/W at ON position,
is indicator segment at lowest point when
connector of water temp. sender gauge
disconnected?

No → Check short circuit in wire harness.

② With the ignition S/W at ON position
and connector of water temp. sender gauge
disconnected, does top segment flash when
connector is grounded?

Yes → Is water temp. sender gauge OK?
      (See page BE-55)
